'''0.28b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that made active participation in matches more rewarding and increased the effects of equipment damage.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Victory bonus reduced to 25%
* Reward for killing enemies increased by 25%
* Now when participating in match equipment breaks down 50% faster

===User Interface===
* Fixed localization errors

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed bug in installer, not the client to update under certain proxy settings
* Optimized firing effects, which should reduce the performance drop when firing
* Removed smoke from shot when using a telescopic sight
* Fixed bug when trying to add funds from the search screen
